review.assessment: The provided diff replaces any prior logic with a naive baseline that splits only on literal spaces, preserves original casing, and returns an unsorted vector from HashMap iteration. It completely omits the required non-alphanumeric splitting, case normalization, and deterministic sorting specified in the task. While the trivial test passes because it ignores order and punctuation, the function does not meet any of the three robustness requirements.

findings.actual: Splits input into tokens like `"hello,"` and `"world!"`, leaving all non-space characters attached to words.
findings.defect: Fails to split on non-alphanumeric characters. The code uses `text.split(' ')`, which violates the requirement to treat any punctuation or whitespace as delimiters.
findings.expected: `[("world", 1), ("hello", 1)]` (or equivalent unsorted pair collection of stripped words)
